To provide an efficient multi-centre infra-structure for generating quality evidence on the utility of new forms of intensive care monitoring and methods for improving the care and outcome of brain-injured patients.
This severely limits the provision of quality evidence demonstrating the clinical utility of their products.

The Brain Monitoring with Information Technology (BrainIT) network provides an infrastructure for monitoring similar to that required by the Pharmaceutical industry in the conduct of trials of new drugs.
